status_vocabulary.SOURCE: explicitly transmitted or stated in the cited primary source
status_vocabulary.INFERENCE: elementary consequence recorded by the laboratory
status_vocabulary.NOT_PROVIDED: not supplied by this chain; no claim of impossibility
status_vocabulary.CONTRADICTED: incompatible with an explicit property of this chain
status_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: the property concerns a different limiting equation or object

properties.limit_equation_obtained_is_viscous_ns: the passage to the limit yields standard incompressible Navier-Stokes with positive viscosity
properties.limit_equation_obtained_is_euler: the passage to the limit yields incompressible Euler after viscosity vanishes
properties.ancient_interval: the limiting object is defined on R^3 x (-infinity,0)
properties.mild_integral_formula: the object satisfies a Stokes/Leray mild formula on every sufficiently long past interval
properties.local_energy_inequality: a suitable/local energy inequality is transmitted
properties.global_velocity_Linf: one scale-independent global pointwise velocity bound is transmitted
properties.global_Linf_t_L3_x: one scale-independent global L-infinity in time, L3 in space bound is transmitted
properties.terminal_zero_L2loc: the terminal trace is zero strongly in local L2
properties.terminal_zero_Sprime: the terminal trace tends to zero in tempered distributions
properties.terminal_point_nonzero: a pointwise terminal normalization |u(0,0)|=1 is transmitted
properties.nontrivial_limit: a quantitative or dynamical witness excludes the zero object
properties.explicit_pressure_control: an explicit pressure decomposition or convergence topology sufficient for the cited rigidity step is transmitted
properties.weighted_euler_energy: the weighted local energy and pressure bounds used in the Type II Euler limit are transmitted

ESS_LOCAL_L3_ZOOM.source: Escauriaza-Seregin-Sverak 2003, proof of the local L3-infinity criterion
ESS_LOCAL_L3_ZOOM.equation: 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes, viscosity 1, unforced, R^3; the limiting pair is eternal on R^3 x R and is restricted to past times for the ancient formulation
ESS_LOCAL_L3_ZOOM.topology: velocity weak-star L-infinity_t L3_x, strong L3_loc and C_t L2_loc; pressure split p1 weak-star L-infinity_t L3/2_x and harmonic p2 vanishing locally

GKP_CRITICAL_ELEMENT.topology: critical element mild in L3; u(t) tends to zero in S' as t approaches its finite maximal time

KNSS_MAXIMUM_ZOOM.equation: incompressible Navier-Stokes, viscosity 1, unforced, R^n; application n=3
KNSS_MAXIMUM_ZOOM.topology: local uniform convergence to a bounded ancient mild solution

SEREGIN_TYPEII_EULER_ZOOM.equation: 3D incompressible Euler limit of a conditional Navier-Stokes Type II rescaling
SEREGIN_TYPEII_EULER_ZOOM.topology: velocity strong L^(3 nu)_loc, weak-star local energy; limiting pressure asserted with weighted bound but no separate displayed convergence topology
